response.overview: A short film shot at the Saline Royale d'Arc-et-Senans during the second session of the Pierre Feuille Ciseaux (rock-paper-scissors) residencies.  An attempt to pay homage to artistic work conceived as the most accomplished manifestation of life; the film organizes the raw footage both as a visual collage - structural analogues of the days spent in the workshop - and as a mirror of spatial and temporal densities (the immensely open fields of vision provided by the Saltworks, the compactness of human activities - the dotted lines of collective life).
response.title: Pierre Feuille ciseaux
